index.hero_sub: Maksims OÜ has been providing accounting, tax and legal services in Tallinn for over 30 years.
index.svc1_body: Accounting setup and advice, plus the preparation of financial, tax, statistical and internal reports.
index.svc2_body: Tax planning and advice, tax residency matters, and the preparation of applications and requests.
index.svc3_body: Company formation, restructuring and liquidation, changes to Commercial Register data, and contract drafting and review.
index.svc4_body: Financial analysis, business plan preparation, recruitment, and applications for permits and licences.
index.svc5_body: HR document management, document preparation and archiving, and translation services.
index.aud_lede: The scope of our services is tailored to your needs, whether you represent a local company, a foreign-owned business or an apartment association.
index.aud1_body: New, growing and established Estonian businesses — accurate accounting and reporting for both day-to-day operations and inspections.
index.aud2_body: We support Estonian companies with foreign owners and e-residents with accounting, reporting and tax matters. Communication and document exchange can take place entirely online. We can also provide a registered office address and contact person service where required.
index.aud3_body: We manage accounting and reporting for apartment associations and communicate clearly with boards, residents and service providers.
index.proc_title: From first conversation to first report
index.proc1_body: We discuss your company's needs, document volume and the appropriate scope of services.
index.proc2_body: We prepare a quote based on your actual workload and the services you need.
index.proc3_body: We take over from your previous accountant — including mid-financial year where necessary — or set up your accounting from scratch.
index.proc4_body: We maintain your accounts, file reports on time and keep you informed about important matters.
index.faq1_a: Yes. You do not need to wait until year-end — we review the accuracy of previous periods, take over the records and continue without interruption.
index.faq2_q: Do you work with companies owned by e-residents and foreign nationals?
index.faq2_a: Yes. We can provide the service entirely online and can also act as the company's contact person in Estonia where required.
index.faq3_q: What languages do you communicate and keep records in?
index.faq3_a: Official reports are filed in Estonian. Day-to-day communication can be in Estonian, Russian or English, and we can also assist with foreign-language documents where necessary.
index.faq4_q: What do document management and secretarial services include?
index.faq4_a: The service includes HR document management, document preparation and archiving, and translation services.
index.faq5_a: Yes. We work with Töötukassa and offer accounting internships at our company.

teenused.page_title: Accounting, Tax, Legal and Business Services in One Place
teenused.page_intro: Five service areas that can be combined to meet your company's needs, from day-to-day accounting to tax, legal and business advice.
teenused.svc1_p1: We organise your accounting around the size and needs of your company, from day-to-day bookkeeping to reporting, the restoration of previous periods and audit preparation. We work with new and established businesses, public-sector bodies, non-profit organisations and apartment associations.
teenused.svc1_li4: Restoration of accounting records for previous periods
teenused.svc2_p1: We advise companies and individuals on tax matters and help plan transactions so that the opportunities, obligations and risks are clear before a decision is made.
teenused.svc2_p2: In Estonia, a company's corporate income tax liability generally arises when profits are distributed. We advise local and international businesses on applying the Estonian tax system and planning cross-border transactions.
teenused.svc2_li4: Preparation of personal income tax returns
teenused.svc2_li5: Registration of tax residents in Estonia
teenused.svc2_li7: Representation before the Estonian Tax and Customs Board
teenused.svc2_li8: Preparation of applications and requests for the Estonian Tax and Customs Board
teenused.svc3_p1: We advise Estonian companies on corporate, commercial and employment law matters.
teenused.svc3_p2: We assist with forming and restructuring Estonian companies, changing Commercial Register data, drafting contracts and arranging company liquidation. We can also provide a registered office address and contact person service where required.
teenused.svc3_li2: Registered office address and contact person service
teenused.svc4_p1: We provide advice on finance, economics and investment to support the management and development of your company. The scope of our work depends on your objectives and the specific assignment.
teenused.svc4_li4: Applications for operating permits and licences
teenused.svc5_p1: Well-organised document management keeps your company's records current, easy to find and stored in accordance with requirements.

ettevottest.page_intro: Maksims OÜ is a Tallinn-based accounting and business services firm that has advised companies since 1993.
ettevottest.about_p1: We manage day-to-day accounting, prepare reports and advise on tax and commercial law matters. The scope of our service is agreed according to the size of your company, its area of activity and the actual workload.
ettevottest.about_p2: Our long-standing experience has helped us develop processes that support accurate accounting, timely reporting and clear communication. Clients receive the information they need about their company's financial position and upcoming obligations.
ettevottest.about_p3: Our tax and legal advice is based on each client's specific circumstances. We assess the opportunities and risks of planned transactions and assist with the formation, restructuring, merger, division and liquidation of Estonian companies.
ettevottest.about_p4: We value a responsible approach, agreed deadlines and attentive communication. We have also supported clients during tax inspections and audits and value long-term relationships built on trust.
ettevottest.career_p1: We welcome both early-career professionals and experienced specialists in finance, economics and accounting.
ettevottest.career_p2: We offer varied work, opportunities for professional development and competitive pay.
ettevottest.training_p1: We offer accounting internships at our company. We share practical knowledge and skills that help interns gain work experience and strengthen their position in the job market. We also work with Töötukassa.
ettevottest.training_p2: After successfully completing an internship, you may apply for a position with our company.
ettevottest.meta_description: Learn about Maksims OÜ, how we work, and our career and internship opportunities.

privaatsus.meta_description: How Maksims OÜ processes personal data submitted through this website.
privaatsus.page_intro: This privacy policy explains what personal data Maksims OÜ collects through this website, why it is used and how long it is retained.
privaatsus.p_controller: Maksims OÜ, Kentmanni 18-45, 10116 Tallinn, Estonia. Email: info@maksims.ee, phone +372 6 270 750.
privaatsus.p_data: Through the quote request form, we collect the contact person's name, company name, email address and phone number, together with the information you provide about the company's activities and document volume. We use this information to respond to your enquiry and prepare a quote. Depending on the nature of the enquiry, the legal basis is your consent or taking steps at your request before entering into a contract.
privaatsus.p_data_demo: This is a demonstration version of the website. Information entered in the quote form is not submitted, stored or shared with Maksims OÜ or any third party.
privaatsus.p_retention: We retain enquiry-related data for up to three years after the last contact and then delete it. If the enquiry leads to a client relationship, we retain the data for the periods prescribed by the Accounting Act and other applicable legislation.
privaatsus.p_retention_demo: The demo form does not submit or store any information entered, so no form data is retained.
privaatsus.p_sharing: We do not sell your personal data or use it for third-party marketing. {{sharingProcessor}} Where required by law, we may disclose data to a competent public authority.
privaatsus.p_rights: You have the right to access your data, request its correction or deletion, restrict processing, object to processing and withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, email info@maksims.ee. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (www.aki.ee).
privaatsus.p_cookies: This website uses no tracking or marketing cookies. Your language choice is stored only in your own browser (localStorage) and is not shared with anyone.
privaatsus.sharing_mailto: The website form opens your email application, so the enquiry reaches us directly by email without using a third-party form service.
privaatsus.sharing_provider: Enquiries submitted through the form are delivered by our service provider {{company.formProvider}} solely for the purpose of forwarding the enquiry to us.
privaatsus.sharing_demo: In this portfolio demo, the form does not submit or store any information entered.
